notes: Reviewed duplicate-identity decisions for the company register. Each entry merges one curated record into another because they are the same company. A pair that is a group and a separate operating entity must NOT be listed here: record it as a corporate relationship instead. Merges are applied by scripts/merge-organizations.ts and are listed in the review file for the batch that made the decision.

merges.reason: Both records are PricewaterhouseCoopers South Africa at the same taxonomy node (PRO-ACCT-AUDIT). The roster spells the firm 'PwC South Africa' and the dossier is more useful under the name people search for, so the region-qualified name survives.
merges.evidence: PwC South Africa's own office directory names the firm as PricewaterhouseCoopers Inc and lists its South African offices, establishing one South African practice rather than two.

merges.reason: Both records describe the same grocery group. The surviving record carries the taxonomy placement and the company's own about page, so it is the better-evidenced record.
merges.evidence: The SPAR Group's own site describes the group as a wholesaler and distributor to independently owned SPAR stores, which is the same business the duplicate record described.

merges.reason: The register held 'Shoprite' and 'Shoprite Holdings' as two companies. They are one JSE-listed group; the holding company name is the correct identity, and the surviving record gains the duplicate's people, location and headcount.
merges.evidence: Shoprite Holdings' own group page is the corporate identity behind the retail brand, so the brand record and the holding-company record are one entity.
